summary: Insurance product innovation and digital distribution training for practical pricing, channel design, and launch planning. Build usable tools and maps.
lede: Digital insurance product development connects proposition design with pricing, underwriting and channel delivery. This course is for insurance professionals responsible for turning customer and market insights into launch-ready products and digital sales journeys. It develops practical skills in segmentation and proposition design, pricing and underwriting worksheets, and mapping quote-and-bind channels, approval controls and launch scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for insurance professionals who need to connect product innovation with digital distribution execution across underwriting, pricing, compliance, and channel delivery.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and familiarity with insurance product terminology. Experience with product sheets, distribution plans, or underwriting guides is helpful, and no programming or actuarial software is required.
